knownLimitations: The differential harness covers the current five supported source shapes; the many source remains outside accepted planner operations and is not treated as an accepted-field case.
The reject-all baseline compares materialized typed rows and applies residual operations in test code; it is a semantic regression oracle, not a benchmark or a claim about host plan construction.
The compiled integration case covers one inner join and does not claim generic aggregate pushdown, CTE scan fusion or global ORDER BY pushdown.
